# CRC32C upstream source

This directory vendors Google CRC32C release 1.1.2 from commit
`02e65f4fd3065d27b2e29324800ca6d04df16126`.

Upstream: https://github.com/google/crc32c
License: BSD 3-Clause; see `LICENSE`.

Only the upstream build files, public headers, and source tree are included.
Tests, benchmarks, and optional integrations are disabled by the parent build.
